sections.title: Species traits
lines: Medium Humanoid (Darfellan). +2 Strength, −2 Dexterity. Land speed 20 ft., swim speed 40 ft. LA +0 and advancement by character class.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks to perform special actions or avoid hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.
Echolocation grants blindsense 20 ft. in water, confined to the water. It locates creatures without removing concealment.
Hold Breath (Ex) allows 8 × Constitution score rounds before checks to avoid drowning are required. Constitution 12 gives 96 rounds. Darfellans breathe air.

Natural bite deals 1d6. When the bite is the sole primary natural weapon, add 1½ times the Strength bonus. An armed full attack can add one secondary bite at −5 to the attack roll and half the Strength bonus to damage. Extra attacks from base attack bonus apply only to the primary weapon.
Racial Hatred adds +2 to attack and damage rolls against sahuagin.
Darfellan is automatic. Aquan and Common are bonus languages. Favored class Barbarian.
Page 144 adds a +4 racial bonus on Handle Animal checks with marine mammals in its combat text. The p. 37 and p. 144 player trait lists omit this bonus.
